summary: There's a part of you that knows a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. Owned, you go after what you want and don't back down and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
body: There's a part of you that knows a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. Owned, you go after what you want and don't back down and you reach, grow, and lift the room. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
gift: At your best: you go after what you want and don't back down, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let drive and anger and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you go after what you want and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Your temper gets ahead of you
Let the reflex make the decision
